newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Japan announces 124 bln yen loans to Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Japan announces 124 bln yen loans to Philippines.

text.p: Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto announced that Japan would extend a 124.3 billion yen loan package to the Philippines in talks with President Fidel Ramos on Sunday, a senior Japanese foreign ministry official said.

The aid covers 14 projects, including two on the southern island of Mindanao where the Philippine government recently concluded a peace agreement with Moslem rebels, and will be disbursed within a year from today, the official said.
The official took part in the talks between Hashimoto and Ramos on the eve of the fourth annual Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum summit.
Ramos promised he would seek a revision to a law which limits the amount of aid the Philippines can accept. The law has handicapped negotiations over several engineering and construction projects.
